kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انغلقت (form VII)
# اِنْغَلَقْتُ (inḡalaqtu) /in.ɣa.laq.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْغَلَقَ (inḡalaqa)
# اِنْغَلَقْتَ (inḡalaqta) /in.ɣa.laq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْغَلَقَ (inḡalaqa)
# اِنْغَلَقْتِ (inḡalaqti) /in.ɣa.laq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْغَلَقَ (inḡalaqa)
# اِنْغَلَقَتْ (inḡalaqat) /in.ɣa.la.qat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
